A '''bombard fleet''' was a formation of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] commanded by a [[Fleet Admiral/Legends|fleet admiral]]. It was comprised of two [[system bombard]]s, two [[force escort]]s, a [[force technical services]], and a [[force support]], for an average of 416 [[Starship/Legends|starships]]. Bombard fleets were deployed to regions where the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] determined that suppression of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] activity was less than even. They were used in instances where the Empire would rather destroy a planet than see it in the hands of the Alliance.
